name: Friggy PEP
description: Friggy PEP — 1,976 punk iguana-frogs, born 1976, inscribed forever on Bitcoin. Part Iggy. Part Pepe. 100% Bitcoin. Celebrating the 50th anniversary of the birth of punk, the disruption that shook pop culture all the way to crypto. A pop and crypto culture homage under PUNK influence: every piece is a fully on-chain recursive inscription, rebuilt in your browser from 117 inscribed layers. Children of the parent 'Friggy PEP 1977'. Fair launch: no VC, no paid KOLs.
